Component numbering in the schematic skips R11: only R12 is present as a single termination resistor, following the same numbering pattern as sibling RTRM drawings DE8113 (skips R7, uses R8) and DE8114 (skips R9, uses R10) -- the termination resistor is consistently numbered two past the last stub-tap resistor; preserved as printed rather than assumed to be a reading error.

Front view silkscreen labels J1 BUS, GND, J3 STUB, J4 STUB, J5 STUB, J6 STUB, and J7 STUB identify connector positions (no J2 BUS label; the right terminal is only shown internally in the schematic via R12) but are not a pin-to-value or labeled table structure, so they were not extracted as a table.

The recommended land pattern shows a staggered arrangement of 13 holes/pads total; the 10,16 mm full pitch is exactly twice the 5,08 mm half-pitch, consistent with a two-row zigzag footprint, but the exact split of the 13 pads between the two staggered rows is not fully resolvable from the printed dimensions alone.
